name: Lago
description: Open source usage-based billing and subscription management platform with metering and invoicing.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://lago:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/lago"
      REDIS_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: {{env.SECRET_KEY_BASE}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/storage:/app/storage
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: lago
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: lago
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-front:
    image: getlago/front:v1.44.0
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-front
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      API_URL: "http://lago-api:3000"
